caption: The drawing consists of three groups of black floral patterns on a beige or off-white background. The largest group is positioned near the top center and includes a cluster of stylized flowers and leaves, depicted with dense, dotted black lines and filled-in textures; this group shows various flower head shapes, stems, and multiple leaf types, all interconnected. Below, on the right side, there is a smaller floral cluster, also rendered in black lines and dots, consisting of three flower heads, several rounded leaves, and a single branching stem. Toward the lower left, there is the smallest group, composed of two small flower heads with leaves and a short stem, similarly illustrated in black. The overall layout leaves significant blank space around the groups, with the color composition limited to black ink against the beige background. The bottom right corner features a small printed text that reads "Chl Bourgoin inv."
title: Embroidered Flower Motif
